userStories.title: Fix always-fail in linter-config.json
userStories.description:
File:  linter-config.json
Check: always-fail
Findings at PRD generation: 1. Fixed by prior stories: 0.
This story fixes exactly 1 finding(s). STOP after 1 iterations, even
if more remain — later stories cover them. Any remaining finding may be
addressed; findings are interchangeable.

Repeat exactly 1 times:
  1. Locate the earliest remaining finding:
       node <LINTER> --lint --checks always-fail --files linter-config.json --show first
  2. Read only the affected range:
       Read(linter-config.json, offset: startLine - 2, limit: (endLine - startLine) + 5)
  3. Apply the fix with Edit(old_string=snippet, new_string=<your fix>).

Tool names above (Read, Edit) are Claude Code's; if you're a different
agent, use your equivalents (e.g. read_file / str_replace, view / create,
fs.readFile / applyPatch — whatever your host exposes). The semantics are
what matter: read a small range around the finding, then replace the
returned snippet exactly.

Then verify:
  node <LINTER> --lint --checks always-fail --files linter-config.json --expect-max 0
